Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
